Weird!

When Rex & Win's dad attempted to run over a traffic aide after getting caught violating the EDSA Busway, Joel Villanueva questioned the public outcry as weird. But nothing is weirder than law enforcement pinning the blame of a suicide on an passing motorist along EDSA. https://t.co/VPpXOwMUJV
